items.summary: ION826 jfrazier@ionis.com Fri, 01/30/2026 - 13:58 Drug Name ION826 Target PLN Disease Myocardial Disease Description ION826, also known as AZD4063, is an investigational siRNA medicine in development for a serious form of myocardial disease called PLN-R14del dilated cardiomyopathy. ION826 uses Bicycle® technology, a Bicycle peptide ligand with high affinity to the transferrin receptor (TFR1) to deliver antisense medicines to muscle tissue, including in the heart. It is the first Bicycle-conjugated siRNA to reach clinical trials. This program is partnered with AstraZeneca. About PLN R14del dilated cardiomyopathy PLN-R14del dilated cardiomyopathy is a serious form of myocardial disease caused by a mutation in the phospholamban (PLN) gene, where the arginine at position 14 (R14del) is deleted. With no approved disease-modifying therapies, people living with the PLNR14del mutation are at higher risk of heart muscle weakening, malignant ventricular arrhythmias and heart failure. Safety and efficacy have not been evaluated by any regulatory authorities for the indication described. Partner AstraZeneca Phase 1 Phase one Therapeutic Area Cardiometabolic Disease Display Order 4

items.title: WAINUA® (eplontersen)
items.summary: WAINUA® (eplontersen) jfrazier@ionis.com Fri, 01/30/2026 - 13:39 Drug Name WAINUA® (eplontersen) Target TTR Disease Hereditary Transthyretin-mediated Amyloid Polyneuropathy Description WAINUA® (eplontersen) is approved for the treatment of the polyneuropathy of hereditary transthyretin-mediated amyloidosis in adults, commonly referred to as hATTR-PN or ATTRv-PN. Please see full U.S. Prescribing Information . Ionis is jointly developing and commercializing WAINUA with AstraZeneca. About Hereditary Transthyretin-mediated Amyloid Polyneuropathy (hATTR-PN) hATTR-PN is caused by the accumulation of misfolded mutated TTR protein in the peripheral nerves. Patients with hATTR-PN experience ongoing debilitating nerve damage throughout their body resulting in the progressive loss of motor functions, such as walking. These patients also accumulate TTR in other major organs, which progressively compromises their function. The damage from misfolded TTR protein accumulation leads to disability within five years of diagnosis and is generally fatal within a decade. Partner AstraZeneca Phase Approved Therapeutic Area Neurology Display Order 3

items.summary: QALSODY® (tofersen) jfrazier@ionis.com Fri, 01/30/2026 - 13:28 Drug Name QALSODY® (tofersen) Target SOD1 Disease SOD1 Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis Description QALSODY® (tofersen) is approved for the treatment of adults with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) who have a mutation, or change, in the superoxide dismutase 1 (SOD1) gene. Please see the full U.S. Prescribing Information . This program is partnered with Biogen. About Superoxide Dismutase 1 (SOD1) Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS) SOD1-ALS is a rare, fatal, neurodegenerative disorder caused by a mutation in the SOD1 gene leading to a progressive loss of motor neurons. As a result, people with SOD1-ALS experience increasing muscle weakness, loss of movement, difficulty breathing and swallowing and eventually succumb to the disease. SOD1-ALS is diagnosed in approximately 2% of all ALS cases, impacting about 330 people in the United States. Approximately 5%-10% of people with ALS have a genetic form of the disease of whom about 20% will have a mutation of the SOD1 gene; however, they may not have a known family history of the disease. Partner Biogen Phase Approved Therapeutic Area Neurology

Please see full U.S. Prescribing Information . About Hereditary Angioedema (HAE) HAE is a rare and potentially life-threatening genetic condition that involves recurrent attacks of severe swelling (angioedema) in various parts of the body, including the hands, feet, genitals, stomach, face and/or throat. HAE is estimated to affect approximately 20,000 people in the U.S. and Europe. Phase Approved Therapeutic Area Other Medicines

items.summary: ION775 jfrazier@ionis.com Fri, 01/30/2026 - 13:03 Drug Name ION775 Target ApoC-III Disease Severe Hypertriglyceridemia Description ION775 is an investigational apoC-III siRNA being evaluated for people with severe hypertriglyceridemia (sHTG). ION775 is designed to maximize durability, with the potential for semiannual dosing. ION775 is Ionis’ first clinical-stage siRNA medicine. About Severe Hypertriglyceridemia (sHTG) sHTG is defined by very high triglyceride (TG) levels of 500 mg/dL and above and characterized by an increased risk of acute pancreatitis (AP), atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease (ASCVD) and other comorbidities. More than 3 million people are living with sHTG in the U.S., including ~1 million who are considered high-risk (TG levels ≥880 mg/dL or TG levels ≥500 mg/dL with AP history or other comorbidities). Safety and efficacy have not been evaluated by any regulatory authorities for the indication described. Phase 2 Phase two Therapeutic Area Cardiometabolic Disease Display Order 4
